name: application-changelog-entry
title: Changelog Entry
description: Dated release card with a version badge, category tags, and grouped bullet lists, driven by a typed version/sections prop contract.
useWhen: Publishing release notes or a product changelog with grouped New/Improved/Fixed items per version.
Each entry needs a scannable version number and date alongside a short headline before the detail list.
You want a single reusable release-card primitive to stack into a changelog feed.
avoidWhen: You need a chronological event timeline with connector lines — use the timelines component instead.
Updates are user-facing activity, not versioned releases — use the Activity Feed component instead.
The changelog has dozens of entries needing pagination or filtering — pair this card with a list/pagination wrapper.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a single fixed-width block with intrinsic sizing; stack multiple entries in your own vertical list or grid to control spacing at each breakpoint.
accessibility: The date uses a semantic <time> element with a machine-readable datetime attribute alongside the human-readable label.
Category badges (New/Improved/Fixed) pair color with a text label, never color alone.
Each category's bullet list is grouped under its own heading so screen readers announce section boundaries.

variants.title: Changelog Entry
variants.description: Release card with a version badge, date, headline, category badge row, and grouped New/Improved/Fixed bullet lists.
accessibility: Each category heading uses distinct color plus text, so the New/Improved/Fixed grouping doesn't rely on color alone.

variants.title: Changelog Entry (Dark)
variants.description: Release card adapted for dark surfaces with the same version badge, category-badge, and grouped-list structure.
accessibility: Version badge, category badges, and list text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
